# Money Tree Leads

> AI-powered lead engine for Canadian realtors. Pre-qualified home buyer and seller leads, scored 0–100 on intent, financing, and timeline, delivered to the realtor's dashboard in real time. One plan: $299/month CAD, first-month refund if you don't close a deal, cancel any time.

Money Tree Leads (legal entity: Money Tree Conversions, Edmonton, Alberta, Canada) helps real estate agents replace cold prospecting with a live stream of warm, pre-qualified leads.

## Key facts

- Audience: real estate agents and realtors in Canada
- What it does: generates and qualifies buyer/seller leads using AI, scoring each lead 0–100 on intent, financing readiness, and purchase timeline
- Delivery: leads stream into a web dashboard the moment they are qualified
- Pricing: single plan, $299/month CAD — no tiers, no contracts
- Guarantee: first-month refund if the realtor doesn't close a deal
- Cancellation: cancel any time
- Sign up: https://app.moneytreeleads.ca/signup
- Log in: https://app.moneytreeleads.ca/login

## How it differs from portal leads

Unlike leads bought from real estate portals — which are often cold, shared between multiple agents, and unvetted — Money Tree Leads delivers exclusive leads that are pre-qualified before they reach the agent, so conversations start warm.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.moneytreeleads.ca/): product overview, live lead feed demo, pricing
- [How It Works](https://www.moneytreeleads.ca/how-it-works): the five-stage AI qualification engine — intent capture (~12,400 signals/day), bot filtering, 23-signal enrichment, MTL Score 0–100 (model trained on 4.1M closed transactions, 70+ delivery threshold), realtor matching in under 4 seconds
- [Pricing](https://www.moneytreeleads.ca/pricing): one plan, $299/month CAD, up to 80 pre-qualified leads/month, full feature list, guarantee and terms, cost comparison vs. portal leads
- [Vs. Portal Leads](https://www.moneytreeleads.ca/vs-portal-leads): side-by-side comparison — portal leads ($600+/mo, shared, form-only, 4–6% close) vs. Money Tree Leads ($299/mo, exclusive, AI-qualified, 18–22% close)
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.moneytreeleads.ca/privacy): how personal information is collected, used, and protected
- [Terms of Service](https://www.moneytreeleads.ca/terms): terms governing use of the service
